+    def _update_selection_poly(self, vmin, vmax):
+        """
+        Update the vertices of the *self.poly* slider to cover the data
+        range *vmin*, *vmax*.
+        """
+        # The vertices are positioned
+        #  1 ------ 2
+        #  |        |
+        #  0, 4 --- 3
+        # Note that we always reconstruct the full list of five vertices
+        # here, rather than updating the existing vertices in place, because
+        # the number of vertices in ``self.poly.xy`` can vary: when *vmin*
+        # equals *vmax*, `.Polygon.set_xy` does not add a separate closing
+        # vertex (the last vertex before closing already matches the first),
+        # so ``self.poly.xy`` only has four rows instead of five.
+        if self.orientation == "vertical":
+            xy = [[.25, vmin], [.25, vmax], [.75, vmax], [.75, vmin],
+                  [.25, vmin]]
+        else:
+            xy = [[vmin, .25], [vmin, .75], [vmax, .75], [vmax, .25],
+                  [vmin, .25]]
+        self.poly.xy = xy
